controls.name: Identity Management
controls.description: Creates and maintains identities used to access company systems.

controls.name: Role-Based Access
controls.description: Assigns permissions through defined roles and responsibilities.

controls.name: Privileged Access Management
controls.description: Restricts and governs elevated access to sensitive systems.

controls.name: Tenant Data Scoping
controls.description: Scopes data access and operations to the intended tenant.

controls.name: Encryption at Rest
controls.description: Protects stored sensitive data using encryption.

controls.name: Encryption in Transit
controls.description: Protects sensitive data while it moves between systems.

controls.name: Secrets Management
controls.description: Controls the storage, access, and rotation of application secrets.

controls.name: PII Handling
controls.description: Defines how personally identifiable information is identified and handled.

controls.name: Data Retention
controls.description: Defines retention and deletion periods for governed data.

controls.name: Centralized Audit Logging
controls.description: Collects security-relevant audit events in a central system.

controls.name: Log Retention
controls.description: Retains logs for a defined and reviewable period.

controls.name: Privileged Action Logging
controls.description: Records actions performed through privileged access.

controls.name: Audit Readiness
controls.description: Maintains reviewable records needed to support audit preparation.

controls.name: Incident Alerting
controls.description: Detects and routes signals that may require incident response.

controls.name: Incident Response Policy
controls.description: Documents roles and procedures for responding to incidents.

controls.name: Incident Response Testing
controls.description: Exercises the documented incident response process.

controls.name: Incident Response Readiness
controls.description: Represents preparedness to detect, coordinate, and test incident response.

controls.name: Prompt Retention
controls.description: Defines how prompts are retained and deleted.

controls.name: Model Training Opt-Out
controls.description: Governs whether customer data is excluded from model training.

controls.name: Prompt Injection Testing
controls.description: Tests AI-enabled features against prompt-injection scenarios.

controls.name: SOC 2 Status
controls.description: Records the directly evidenced status of the organization's SOC 2 examination.
